mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_memory_summary (session_id, summary, up_to_message_id, summarized_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{r.summary}, #{r.upToMessageId}, #{r.summarizedCount}, now()) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, up_to_message_id = EXCLUDED.up_to_message_id, summarized_count = EXCLUDED.summarized_count, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO flow_user_memory (user_id, memory_key, memory_value, source_session_id, source_turn_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{key}, #{value}, #{sessionId}, #{turnId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, memory_key) DO UPDATE SET memory_value = EXCLUDED.memory_value, source_session_id = EXCLUDED.source_session_id, source_turn_id = EXCLUDED.source_turn_id, updated_at = now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM flow_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_key = #{key}
DELETE FROM flow_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM flow_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
